text: Completed reusable fold-safe ModelSpec execution across spectral and constrained programs. Added validated SolverExecutionRecord metadata bound to the fit attestation; training-scope provenance checks now cover frames, effective operators, and policy outputs; ModelTransformation preserves row ids, input feature identity, declared output coordinates, source identity, and provenance. Added fold-local exact quadratic GPCA and nonnegative constrained canonical pipelines with separately inspectable programs/operators/settings/diagnostics and honest GlobalSpectralOptimum vs StationaryPoint guarantees. Existing cache/leakage/stage/policy gates remain. Evidence: ModelSpec lifecycle/execution suites 15/15 JVM and 15/15 JS; complete multivar 350/350 JVM and 350/350 JS; diff check clean and focused compilation warning-clean.
